title: Model picker host connection
responsibility: Connects the picker to its MCP host or explicitly enabled standalone preview endpoint.

inputs.name: providerPickerClient.receive
inputs.description: Callback receiving picker snapshots from preview initialization or qualifying host tool results.

outputs.name: providerPickerClient
outputs.description: Client with preview flag, async tool call and close. Standalone preview requires both the body marker and a top-level window, posts JSON to /tools and loads open_model_picker immediately. Otherwise connects an MCP App and forwards structured results.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects preview HTTP failures and MCP tool error results with guidance; connection, request and JSON errors can also propagate.
